title: Give the name of the league with the highest matches of all time and how ma
question:
Give the name of the league with the highest matches of all time and how many matches were played in the said league.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: league with highest matches of all time refers to MAX(COUNT(league_id));

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    L.XCL_005 AS league_name,
    COUNT(M.XCL_006) AS match_count
FROM League L
JOIN Match M ON L.XCL_003 = M.XCL_007
GROUP BY L.XCL_003, L.XCL_005
ORDER BY match_count DESC
LIMIT 1

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT l.XCL_005
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.XCL_008 = l.XCL_003
GROUP BY l.XCL_003
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;
